title: Time Based Key-Value Store
kidExplanation: Remember values with timestamps. Ask for a key at time t: latest value not after t.
plainProblem: LeetCode 981: Time Based Key-Value Store. Restate the official prompt in your own words, list inputs and outputs, then solve a tiny example by hand before coding.

thinkingSteps.title: Brute force idea
thinkingSteps.body: For Time Based Key-Value Store, first describe a slow but correct approach (often nested loops or rescanning).

thinkingSteps.title: Why it is slow
thinkingSteps.body: Count the loops. If work looks like n×n, say so. Google interviewers want that honesty.

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: To implement a time-based key-value store, we can use a dictionary to store the values associated with each key. For each key, we store a list of tuples representing the timestamp and the corresponding value. When querying a key at a specific timestamp, we perform binary search on the list of timestamps associated with that key to find the largest timestamp less than or equal to the given timestamp.
